svg.text: Casino sign - parts list: strips, LED counts and cutting list
3 strips, 14 pieces, 164 LEDs = 2.73 m of strip (60 LEDs per metre, pitch 16.7 mm).
Cut the strip only between two LEDs (at the cut marks). See layout-diagram.svg for the positions.
Letters (strip D11): LEDs per letter group and LED index range
The letter pieces are joined in reading order (CASINO, then OPEN) with wire jumpers;
together they are the one strip 'letters' on pin D11.
Grove sticks: 10 arrow sticks + the CLOSED light (in the shield, not cut)
Stick body 83 x 10 mm, LED window 74 x 4 mm; arrow geometry and drill template: arrow_sticks/.
